wheel_diameter_mm.source: Nominal tyre diameter; loaded radius unmeasured

firmware_counts_per_m.source: MOTION.md firmware conversion, not measured ground travel

total_mass_kg.source: Stage0 placeholder; operator must weigh robot

caster_forward_mm.source: Retained IMU WB80 hypothesis, not a caster survey

body_width_mm.source: Conservative full-width envelope including reader; not chassis shape

body_height_mm.source: Stage0 placeholder conservative chassis box height

wheel_inertia_kg_m2.source: Solid-cylinder estimate with nominal wheel mass/radius

drive_tau_ms.source: Provisional drive response, NOT measured transient

coast_tau_ms.source: Provisional passive coast response, NOT active brake

max_assumed_duty_fraction.source: UNVALIDATED linear extension of60-70percent DM1 slope to firmware80percent cap; high-duty wheelies NOT calibrated

stall_torque_nm.source: Stage0 cap; motor stall torque unmeasured

start_duty_fraction.source: DM1 used12percent kick; static breakaway threshold not independently measured

sonar_face_offset_mm.source: Provisional face at servo axis, not surveyed

servo_slew_deg_s.source: Approximation from3.6ms/degree settle fit; not measured slew

line_forward_mm.source: Old host effective fit, NOT physical survey

line_left_mm.source: Operator physical GP27-GP26 separation; do not substitute fitted20.9

line_clearance_mm.source: Old approximate board height; current pose unconfirmed

barcode_clearance_mm.source: Nominal flat setup only; not terrain-following

imu_forward_mm.source: Retained IMU geometry, survey provenance unconfirmed

imu_axle_height_mm.source: Assume old130mm referenced flat surface; subtract32.5mm radius; DATUM UNCONFIRMED

field_east_gauss.source: Stage0 illustrative magnetic field, not local calibration
